blind_replay_1273043_to_1285601.how: derive a 1273043-only sigdb (the current sigdb ported backwards, every pattern regenerated from 1273043 bytes), then port it forward seeing only the 1273043 exe, that sigdb and the 1285601 exe; truth = the hand-verified sigdb resolved on 1285601 (its build record is lab-verified)

hand_check_of_derived_sigdb.the_3_extra_symbols: gameplay/DismantleBlock 0x2208b0, DismantleBlock2 0x221430, PickUpProp 0x222440 on 1273043: today's @gameplay/Dismantle.calls patterns carry 1285601 stack offsets and match nothing on 1273043; the tool found the call sites in the matched caller. Checked by hand: PickUpProp is byte-identical (normalised), DismantleBlock/DismantleBlock2 have 0.86/0.81 instruction-sequence similarity, are bound by the identical caller's call sites and keep link order (0x2208b0 < 0x221430 < 0x222440 like 0x226440 < 0x226fd0 < 0x227f50).

layout_moves_found.+0x1c00: 15 world-struct constants (world.storage 0xe15dc0 -> 0xe179c0, world.jobs, program count/table, gameplay event map, ...): the program table grew (docs/re/emf-core.md)
layout_moves_found.+0x8: 6: program stride 0x1f20 -> 0x1f28 and the program-context slice fields (job.entity_list/count, other_count, other_tpl_count)
layout_moves_found.-0x700000: 3: gameplay/storage.pending 0xeb9ef0 -> 0x7b9ef0, pending_count, queues: the world storage shrank by 7 MB in front of the pending-event buffer between the builds (12 corroborating sites)
